scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd apps/vanilla build:package && bun -e 'for (const root of ["packages/core/dist", "apps/vanilla/dist"]) for await (const path of new Bun.Glob("**/*.d.ts").scan({ cwd: root })) { const file = `${root}/${path}`; await Bun.write(file, (await Bun.file(file).text()).replace(/\.ts(?=")/g, ".js")); }'
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/vanilla dev
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/vanilla build
scripts.docs:check: bun run scripts/generate-api-reference.ts --check && bun run scripts/check-docs.ts
scripts.test:conformance:vue: bun run build:packages && playwright test -c apps/vue/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:conformance:foldkit: bun run build:packages && playwright test -c apps/foldkit/playwright.config.ts
